mapper.select: SELECT json_build_object('type','FeatureCollection','features', json_agg(f)) FROM ( SELECT json_build_object( 'type','Feature', 'properties', json_build_object('adcode',adcode,'name',name,'level',level,'center',center), 'geometry', ST_AsGeoJSON(geom)::json ) AS f FROM admin_area ) t

select a.adcode as adcode, a.name as district, count(p.gid) as total, round((ST_Area(a.geom::geography)/1e6)::numeric, 2) as "areaKm2", count(*) filter (where p.category = 'school') as school, count(*) filter (where p.category = 'hospital') as hospital, count(*) filter (where p.category = 'mall') as mall, count(*) filter (where p.category = 'park') as park from admin_area a left join poi p on p.adcode = a.adcode::text where a.adcode = #{adcode} group by a.adcode, a.name, a.geom
